result.title: TrajWAM: Trajectory-Conditioned Future Learning for Vision-Language Driving
result.comment: 22 pages, including supplementary material. Code and model weights: https://github.com/FangWD520/TrajWAM
result.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) connect future scene prediction with action planning for autonomous driving. Each driving record pairs an executed ego trajectory with its observed future, providing a factual outcome for learning this connection. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-conditioned WAM that improves vision-language driving through auxiliary bird's-eye-view (BEV) future learning. An ego-trajectory query conditions DINOv3-aligned BEV predictions from shared planner representations. Training combines factual reconstruction under the executed trajectory with one-sided feature separation under an unlabeled perturbed trajectory. Together, these objectives train the shared planner to generate driving waypoints. Native inference directly generates waypoints and bypasses the auxiliary future-prediction branch. On all 220 Bench2Drive routes, TrajWAM achieves 91.53 Driving Score and 75.45% Success Rate, exceeding a schedule-matched planning-only fine-tuning baseline by 5.31 Driving Score points and eight successful routes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TrajWAM，以自车轨迹查询条件化 BEV 未来预测，作为自动驾驶 VLM 规划器的辅助训练任务：在执行轨迹下做事实重建，并在未标注的扰动轨迹下做单侧特征分离，推理时直接输出 waypoints 而绕过未来预测分支。
AI.relevance_reason: 「共享规划表示 + 辅助视觉未来预测 + 推理期绕过」的设置，可供核查 latent 视觉预测是否真正改变内部状态，以及事实重建与扰动对比之间的训练信号贡献分配；但任务为驾驶规划，未涉及推理期 latent 生成或多步视觉推理。
